files.name: pong.html
files.title: Pong
files.description: Play the computer, a friend, or watch a demo; keyboard, mouse or touch.
files.author: Jake Gordon
files.changes: Combined game.js, pong.js, the menu images and sounds into one file (assets inlined as data URIs); replaced the sidebar with an on-page controls hint; scaled the canvas to fit its frame; added Enter/W/S/arrow keys and mouse/touch paddle control; Esc quits without window.confirm, which sandboxed iframes block; FPS overlay off. The MIT notice is kept at the top of the file.

files.name: tiny-yurts.html
files.title: Tiny Yurts
files.description: Connect yurts to farms in a cosy road-building puzzle (js13k 2023).
files.author: burntcustard
files.changes: Added a small script before the game that substitutes in-memory storage when localStorage/sessionStorage throw, so the game starts in the explorer's sandboxed iframe. Game code is unchanged; progress lasts until the page closes.
